scope: Implementation completion handoffs with fictional photo-export controls.

source_contract.implementation: The outer Verify the result step owns completion; routing and implement hand off to it without restarting the build for that transition.
source_contract.review: Read unchanged maintaining artifacts to assess in-scope requirements; presence or topic overlap creates no update obligation. Report concrete unmet requirements within the requested comparison and remain read-only.
source_contract.coordinator: Reassess relevant findings under the existing threshold and reconcile authorized affected state before completion.
source_contract.verification: Reuse adequate current review evidence and add only uncovered acceptance checks; return newly uncovered defects through the existing handoff.

deterministic_controls.evidence_limit: Constructed answers and verification records test evaluator boundaries; actual agent behavior is not observed.

live.reason: Live evaluation and sandbox debugging are outside this task.

smallest_next_action: Use a verified execution boundary for a separately scoped behavioral comparison, inspecting actual reads, findings, handoffs, verification and saved content.

standards_and_privacy.coverage: Prior sanitized-baseline review of 26 paths retained; a scoped Standards follow-up reviewed all seven cleanup files in full context.

spec.coverage: Prior baseline review retained; a scoped follow-up reviewed the seven-file cleanup for required behavior, scope, ownership, loading and defect-return boundaries.

independent_review.limits: Reviewers inspected source and did not run live evaluations. Final validation and publication checks are coordinator-owned.
